hooks.name: player_commands_sent_v2
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Paper's PlayerCommandSendEvent)

rust_summary: the root commands a player's level hides from their command tree, which a mod may put back (`native_player_commands_sent_v2`), leaving `native_player_commands_sent` as it was.
doc_summary: `native_player_commands_sent_v2(player, name, names, names_hidden)`: an additive version of `native_player_commands_sent`, heard right after v1, with the root commands the player's level hides in `names_hidden`; one a mod moves into `names` is sent with its subtree, so a granted command completes in the player's chat box. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_commands_sent_v2@.
